095    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int currentPcm, int previousPcm, int pumpSuspended, int calculationAvailable, int cgmAvailable, int closedLoopPreferred, int sufficientClosedLoopParams) {
096        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
097            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(230, 0),
098            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
099            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
100            new byte[]{ (byte) currentPcm },
101            new byte[]{ (byte) previousPcm },
102            new byte[]{ (byte) pumpSuspended },
103            new byte[]{ (byte) calculationAvailable },
104            new byte[]{ (byte) cgmAvailable },
105            new byte[]{ (byte) closedLoopPreferred },
106            new byte[]{ (byte) sufficientClosedLoopParams }));
